parts.text: A clear visual metaphor for quickly sketching an idea before refining it: close-up overhead view of a designer's hand using a graphite pencil to draw three rough thumbnail compositions of the same simple ceramic vase on a large sheet of cream paper. The rough thumbnails visibly try different object placements, lighting arrows and framing, with sparse construction lines and unfinished outlines. A few colored swatches sit off to the side but the drawings are deliberately rough, not polished. The pencil tip and rough composition sketches are the focal point. Wide landscape 16:9, one coherent scene, no readable text, no numbers, no brand marks. Editorial concept illustration for a Thai technology news explainer. Neutral navy and warm cream, realistic materials, clear composition. No text, no letters, no logo, no official product UI. This is explicitly an illustrative analogy, not evidence of a real product feature.
